logp.method_description: The log Po/w of the complexes was measured using the traditional shake-flask method, in accordance with established protocols. Equal volumes of pre-saturated n-octanol and water were combined with the compound and agitated for 48 hours at room temperature using an orbital shaker to facilitate equilibrium partitioning. Following phase separation, UV-visible spectroscopy was used to analyze the concentration of the compound in each layer. The partition coefficient was determined using: log Po/w = log([C]octanol / [C]water) where [C]octanol and [C]water  shows the concentrations (based on absorbance) in the organic and aqueous phases, respectively.
